load_family: smooth_mixture (25 signed sine modes, unit norm, qscale 1 Pa)
error_metric: per-design relative L2 over all five scaled fields on the 41x41 grid (w-only also stored)

families.B3L: B3L modal transfer, log-magnitude targets (post hoc)

post_hoc.B3L: Added after the first E2 run (results/e2_reduced_field) showed B3 tail errors at narrow plates; selected on validation only; reported separately from the pre-declared families.

step_a.rank_rule: smallest rank whose validation p95 projection error (all five scaled fields) is <= 1%

decision_gate.decision: Structure-aware model does not meet the target with <= 40 designs; the SSSS family remains a meaningful testbed for the physics-vs-data comparison.
decision_gate.rule: median <= 1.0% and p95 <= 3.0% (validation, mean over seeds); decision threshold 40 designs; fixed before running E2

timing.note: Same output for all: five scaled 41x41 fields. Local CPU, single process, median of repeats; B0 includes plate construction and the 25-mode closed-form solve.
